description: BRIEF.md P1 (alex via env_discord 2026-10-24). Apocrita compute pre-approved for this lane; evidence rule: beads close with logs only.
acceptance_criteria:
HF dataset Station-house/marin-32b-neuron-atlas surveyed: README + pilot/fineweb-10m-sparse/MANIFEST.json read, one shard pulled from each of captured_mass/ and sparse/layer=00/ with parquet schemas documented

close_reason: P1 verification complete 2026-10-26: local data/pilot matches HF tree Station-house/marin-32b-neuron-atlas exactly — 1,060/1,060 files (1,054 parquet + 3 MANIFEST.json + 3 provenance.json), 411.9 GB (384 GiB), 0 missing, 0 extra, 0 byte-size mismatches vs HF API (hf_tree.json, 3-page cursor pagination). sha256 spot-checks pass on all 3 trees (fineweb-10m-sparse seg0000, fineweb-1m part-00000, stage-a-100k part-00000). Per-MANIFEST tally: fineweb-10m-sparse 81/81 entries (271.3 GB), fineweb-1m 488/488 (107.8 GB), stage-a-100k 488/488 (32.8 GB). The rumored '8 missing' = the 8 non-parquet files (2 repo + 6 metadata) counted in the 1,062 file total — all present. Pull was 100% complete, not 99%.

comments.author: dawn
comments.text: Survey complete (evidence in survey/): README + pilot/fineweb-10m-sparse/MANIFEST.json read. TRUE TOTAL via HF tree API with cursor pagination (22 pages, limit=100, Link-header cursors): 411,904,202,313 bytes = 411.90 GB = 0.375 TiB across 1,062 files (fineweb-10m-sparse 271.34 GB / fineweb-1m 107.81 GB / stage-a-100k 32.76 GB) — sub-TB, local data/ pull per BRIEF. Shard verification: captured_mass/seg0000 sha256 2ab1f015...27df matches MANIFEST (913,797,213 B); sparse/layer=00/sorted-00000 sha256 0f106473...feb9 matches MANIFEST (3,975,840,031 B). Schemas: captured_mass = token_idx:uint32, layer:uint8, raw:float, norm:float (65.5M rows, 16k row groups); sparse = token_idx:uint32, neuron:uint16, gate:halffloat, up:halffloat, layer:int32 (639.7M rows). act=gate*sigmoid(gate)*up recompute verified. Bulk pull running in background (survey/pull.sh -> survey/pull.log, ~55 MB/s, ETA ~2h).

comments.author: dawn
comments.text: Pull v1 (snapshot_download) died ~20:09Z 2026-10-25, no traceback/OOM in survey/pull.v1.log — killed externally at ~40GB on disk. v3 restarted (survey/pull_v3.sh, log survey/pull_v3.log): per-file curl -C - resume from tree-API filelist (survey/filelist.json, 1,062 files / 411,904,202,313 B), 6 workers, per-file size check + final whole-tree verify of count+bytes.
